audit.whatIsWrong: The lane is written as EVEN with a poke-weathering framing ('Weather the poke'), but every why, spike and prose block describes Quinn bullying a melee-range Lillia from level 1 to first item.
audit.why: 54.86% over 257 games with Quinn owning six of seven chart rows. The only Lillia stage is level 6.
audit.corrected: Ratings on the contested rows adjusted to reflect Quinn's ownership (rows 0 and 3 to 7/10, row 4 to 4/10) rather than the flat 5-6/10 template. diff/diffRating left at EVEN 6/10 — the 8/10 carry threat and her scaling justify it, and the mirror did not move them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 3 and 4 read Skill, Skill, Skill while their captions say you punish 'a melee Lillia at every last-hit', that you 'out-trade a pre-item Lillia', and that level 6 is 'her one flip window'.
audit.why: Packet chart is Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, Lillia, Quinn, Quinn and the audited mirror set exactly rows 0, 3 and 4 to Quinn, Quinn, Lillia.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 3 to Quinn, row 4 to Lillia, in matched full/content pairs, with the row ratings moved to the inverse of the mirror's.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] calls Lilting Lullaby 'a charm-into-DOT setup' — Lillia has no charm; her R applies Drowsy, then sleep, and sleeping targets take bonus damage on being woken. The two facts that matter here are missing entirely: her R cancels Behind Enemy Lines, and Blooming Blows' outer edge deals true damage.
audit.why: Kit: R 'become Drowsy before falling asleep… take extra damage on being forcibly woken up', 150s at rank 1, flagged hardCC. Q 'extra true damage on the edge', 6s at rank 1. Quinn's R is a channel any CC cancels. Both appear in missingInteractions.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text, whys[4] and wants.foe[1] restate the R correctly and name the channel cancel; breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2] and report[5].t carry the 150s / 6s / 12s numbers and the true-damage edge.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mercury's Treads are recommended without noting that Blooming Blows' edge damage is true damage.
audit.why: Tenacity does help against the R sleep, so the boot is still right — but MR is not the answer to her Q edge.
audit.corrected: Stated in the cooldown block and report[5].t; the item string is left alone because Merc Treads remain correct for the R.
